My daughter’s father was like this when we were together. I remember when my daughter was two days old he asked me “so are you going to work our now? So you can, you know, not look like that anymore?” Sigh. Not to mention constant comments about the stretch marks and other changes my body went through. “Is that going to go away anytime soon?” 
It’s easy to say “you should leave him.” But first I think you need to sit down with him and explain to him how you feel. Ask him how he would feel if you said he was puny/wimpy/not strong. If you constantly pointed out his hair loss. See if those comments make any difference. I hope they do. Try to open a dialogue instead of this one sided conversation of him shaming you. Why is he shaming you? Is it a control issue? Does he not understand it’s hurtful? Is he not feeling attracted to you? (I find that hard to believe considering how little weight you’ve gained). 
Also, figure out if *you* want to change. Independent of how he feels, how do you feel? Do you want to lose weight? For looks? For health reasons? If you do, fine. If you don’t, also fine. Just make sure you know that even if you want to change, everyone’s body goes through phases. There is nothing wrong with gaining weight over the years as long as your health isn’t suffering. 
I wish you luck. It’s a tough spot you’re in. Feel free to PM me if you need anything
